honest_wall: Finite range only: no composite n <= 1000000 has phi(n) | (n - 1) (the conjecture stays OPEN beyond it), while the 2-Lehmer relaxation phi(n) | (n - 1)^2 already has solutions below 10^4 (and is thus strictly weaker). A Lehmer counterexample would be odd, squarefree and Carmichael, with >= 15 distinct prime factors and n > 10^26.
references: Lehmer 1932 (posed the problem; counterexample odd, squarefree, >= 7 prime factors)
Pomerance 1977, Pacific J. Math. (N(L,x) = O(x^{1/2} log^{3/4} x))
